capabilities: Render conversations in messaging-app style from chatterbox code blocks
Write messages, comments, capsules, and delimiters with directional markers
Embed Obsidian Flavored Markdown blocks within conversations
Configure per-author colors, widths, and rendering modes via YAML
Style blocks with CSS classes and author data attributes
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render chat-style conversations inside notes, which is useful for documenting LLM chats or scripted dialogues.
summary: Code-block renderer that displays dialogues and conversations styled like messaging apps such as WhatsApp, Discord, or Slack.
